summary: Reason about lost replies, duplicated work and partial failures in multi-service ML workflows.
outcomes: Distinguish timeout from proof of failure
Design bounded retries and deduplication for side effects
sequence: Trace a request whose reply is lost
Recover from a partially completed workflow

visual.question: Did the operation fail, or did only its reply disappear?
visual.interaction: Drop messages and compare retries with and without deduplication

practice.success: Duplicate requests do not duplicate committed outputs under the declared storage model
